entries.33c0d7f2dfc838b8: From April 2026, the company starts a three-year medium-term business plan, 'Saibo Medium-Term Vision 2028'. Its themes are 'developing and expanding high value-added areas of the textile business', 'maintaining and strengthening a stable earnings base in the real estate utilization business', and 'taking on new initiatives in each business'. In the textile business, it will expand sales of environmentally friendly yarns and functional materials, expand proposal products for uniforms, develop new customers for printed processed products, and strengthen handling of items such as disaster-prevention tents. In the real estate utilization business, it will continue renovating and improving the facilities of its two large commercial facilities, and states that it will keep the two buildings coexisting as attractive properties in cooperation with AEON MALL Co., Ltd.
